bayts.text: Praise to our Lord, the Near, the Forgiver of sin, the Answerer, to every repentant one who turns back, in awe and remorse;
invoking blessings upon the Beloved, our rescuer from faults, and upon his Family, possessors of hearts, and the Companions, people of nobility.
That said: truly I, O Generous, am disobedient, guilty and blameworthy, full of pretensions yet destitute, afflicted with grief and distress.
So forgive me all sins, remove from me all afflictions, and conceal all my faults, and likewise for every Muslim.
And open for me the door of good things, close from me the door of evils, save me from deceptive illusion, and lead me along the middle of the highway.
And grant me here guidance, and tomorrow suffice me against perdition; restrain from me the enemies, and bestow upon me protection.
To You I flee and repent, seeking forgiveness from sins, that I may part from faults that hinder me from wisdom.
I have turned my face to You, O Eternal Refuge (Ṣamad), seeking from You right guidance, by the standing of the Trusted One, the cause of every living soul.
Upon him be the best of blessings, and upon his Family, possessors of sacred bonds, with his faithful Companions: a blessing that effaces all my sin.
O Kind One, O Lord of bounties, grant me Your help at every time, and restrain from me every trial (fitna) and every punishment.
I am a mere servant, O Majestic, inexperienced, dull and lowly; my sin is great and heavy, but You are the Possessor of generosity.
And be my Protector forever, and never cease to be my Eternal Refuge, and suffice me against every envier, from violating my sanctities.
And be my Helper, and never cease to be Guardian and Refuge for me, and lead me to the heights, and never cease honouring me.
And open to me, O Knowing One, an opening that makes me wise, and lead me along the straight path, by the standing of him who goes before.
By the Chosen One (Al-Muṣṭafā), the Guide, the Trustworthy: he is the intercessor of sinners, the honoured and firmly established, the orator of the nations.
Upon him be the best of blessings, by which I may gain the best of gifts, until I accompany the faithful, possessors of eminence and turbans.
And upon his Family and his Companions, after greeting him with peace, that I may follow him in action and in character.
And keep me safe, O Peace (Salām), from whatever leads to blame, and suffice me against the evil of words and the evil eye of creatures,
of the serpent and the scorpion, the near and the stranger, the sound and the sinner, and of what comes in light and in darkness.
Make easy for me the hardness of affairs, and smooth my passage, and suffice me at all times against whatever brings punishments.
In You, my God, I seek help: so save me from the Accursed, from his contending party, and from everyone arrogant.
And cleanse my heart of doubts, of fabrications and of lies, and subject to me kings and every criminal oppressor.
And guide me, O my Lord, to what You have chosen for me, lead me by the Prophet, and heal all my sicknesses.
You are the end of my journey, You are the fulfilment of my need: so save me from deception, and save every Muslim.
And save me from going astray, or from being led astray, or from slipping, or from being made to slip, in any place, among Arabs and non-Arabs.
And revive through me the religion of the one followed, without affectation; grant me freedom of action in Your unfathomable, inscrutable universe.
Grant me perfect courtesy (Adab); through me suffice against all toil; grant me to be transformed by Your instructing outpouring.
